decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - 1	Due to the depth of the single-storey rear extension and the location of the first floor rear extension the proposal is considered to be harmful to the neighbours' living conditions through undue loss of light and enclosure contrary to adopted Unitary Development Plan policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) and the Council's Residential Extension Guidelines.

Condition : 2 - 2	Due to the lack of front setback on the two-storey side extension and the bulky appearance created on the southern side of the house due to the dormer in addition to the two-storey side extension, the proposal would be harmful to the appearance of the house and would be out of character with the houses in the surrounding area contrary to adopted Unitary Development Plan policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) and the Council's Residential Extension Guidelines (October 2003).
description: Erection of two storey side extension part single storey and part two storey rear extension and erection of side and roof extension to house
